# AGENTS.md Digest (auto-generated by Phase 0)

## Stack
- Backend: FastAPI / SQLAlchemy / pytest
- Frontend: Next.js / Jest / npm
- Mac/Unix shell — use `validate.sh`, not `validate.ps1`

## Validation commands (exact)
- Backend targeted: `backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests/<path> -v`
- Backend broad: `bash validate.sh`
- Frontend targeted: `cd frontend && npm test -- --runInBand <pattern>`
- Frontend typecheck/build: `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit` or `npm run build`

## Repo conventions
- Branch naming: `feat|fix|refactor|chore/<scope>`
- Conventional commits, atomic
- Pydantic v2 (model_validate, model_dump, @field_validator, ConfigDict)
- SQLAlchemy: selectinload/joinedload for relationships in lists
- TypeScript: no bare `any`, prefer `unknown` + narrow
- Keep CRLF-safe on Windows when touching project text files

## Tooling
- Python venv: `backend/.venv/bin/python` on Mac (Windows uses `Scripts/python.exe`)
- Network policy: default no network during tests; ADC creds may block backend validation
- Observability gates: `ENABLE_OBSERVABILITY=true` (backend), `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_RUM=true` (frontend RUM)

## Reference
- Full AGENTS.md at repo root
- Local dev DB: Cloud SQL Proxy on 127.0.0.1:5432 (see user memory `reference_local_dev_db.md`)
